title: Tawa Chicken Champ
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilli) powder 1 tsp
steps.romanUrdu: -Kashmiri lal mirch (Kashmiri red chilli) powder 1 tsp

steps.instruction: -Cut chicken fillets in thin slices with the help of knife & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chicken fillets ko knife ki madad sa thin slices mein cut ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a frying pan,add cumin seeds,button red chillies,black peppercorns,coriander seeds & dry roast on medium flame until fragrant.
steps.romanUrdu: -Frying pan mein zeera,sabut lal mirch,sabut kali mirch aur sabut dhania dal dein aur khusbu anay tak dry roast ker lein.

steps.instruction: -In a spice mixer,add roasted spices,grind to make a powder & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: -Spice mixer mein roasted spices dal dein aur grind ker ka powder tayyar ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl,add yogurt,raw papaya paste,ginger garlic paste,ground spices,salt,turmeric powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder,garam masala powder & whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Bowl mein dahi,kacha papita paste,adrak lehsan paste,ground spices,namak,haldi powder,Kashmiri lal mirch powder aur garam masala powder dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add chicken pieces & mix well,cover & marinate for 1 hour.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chicken pieces dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker 1 hour kliya marinate ker lein.

steps.instruction: -On griddle,add cooking oil,onion & sauté until translucent.
steps.romanUrdu: -Tawa per cooking oil aur pyaz dal dein aur translucent ho janay tak sauté ker lein.

steps.instruction: -Add marinated chicken & mix well,cover & cook on low flame for 18-20 minutes then cook on high flame until it dries up & oil separates.
steps.romanUrdu: -Marinated chicken dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur dhak ker halki ancch per 18-20 minutes kliya paka lein phir tez ancch per sukh janay aur oil alag ho janay tak pake lein.

steps.instruction: -Add onion,ginger,green chilli,fresh coriander,cover & simmer on low flame for 2 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: -Pyaz,adrak,hari mirch aur hara dhania dal ker dhak dein aur halki ancch per 2 minute kliya dum per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -Garnish with lemon slices & serve with naan!
steps.romanUrdu: -Lemon slices sa garnish ker lein aur naan ka saath serve karein!
